Name: Cascader Purpose
Description: 需要从一组相关联的数据集合进行选择例如省市区公司层级等分级数据

Name: Cascader Scenario
Description: 从一个较大的数据集合中进行选择需多级分类进行分隔方便选择

Name: Cascader Difference
Description: 比Select组件灵活可选择不限层级中的选项节约纵向空间

Name: Cascader Behavior
Description: 点击选项逐级展开下一级面板进行选择

Name: Type Multiple
Description: 多选级联选择器支持复选框

Name: Type Search
Description: 带搜索功能的级联选择器

Name: Size Large
Description: 大尺寸级联选择器高度40px

Name: Size Default
Description: 默认尺寸级联选择器高度32px

Name: Size Small
Description: 小尺寸级联选择器高度28px

Name: Selector Padding
Description: 级联选择器左右内边距12px

Name: Error Focus Shadow
Description: 错误聚焦状态红色阴影

Name: Panel Margin Top
Description: 级联面板与选择器间距4px

Name: Panel Min Width
Description: 级联面板最小宽度下拉菜单宽度不低于672

Name: Column Min Width
Description: 级联面板每列最小宽度120px

Name: Column Max Height
Description: 级联面板每列最大高度256px

Name: Column Border Right
Description: 级联面板列右侧分隔线

Name: Column Padding
Description: 级联面板列上下内边距4px

Name: Option Hover Background
Description: 级联选项悬停灰色背景

Name: Option Hover Color
Description: 级联选项悬停深色文字

Name: Option Active Background
Description: 级联选项激活浅蓝背景

Name: Option Active Color
Description: 级联选项激活蓝色文字

Name: Option Selected Background
Description: 级联选项选中浅蓝背景

Name: Option Selected Color
Description: 级联选项选中蓝色文字

Name: Option Disabled Color
Description: 级联选项禁用灰色文字

Name: Option Disabled Background
Description: 级联选项禁用透明背景

Name: Option Disabled Cursor
Description: 级联选项禁用禁止光标

Name: Multiple Check Strictly
Description: 默认父子节点关联选中

Name: Search Show
Description: 级联选择器支持搜索功能

Name: Search Result Panel
Description: 搜索时显示搜索结果面板

Name: Search Result Path Show
Description: 搜索结果显示完整路径

Name: Search Result Path Color
Description: 搜索结果路径灰色文字

Name: Clear Show
Description: 级联选择器支持清除按钮

Name: Clear Icon
Description: 清除按钮圆形关闭图标

Name: Loading Show
Description: 级联选择器支持异步加载

Name: Empty Show
Description: 级联选择器支持空状态

Name: Keyboard Navigation
Description: 支持上下左右箭头键盘导航

Name: Primary Color
Description: 级联选择器主色调蓝色#165DFF
